title: SQL Injection Login Bypass
impact: Authentication bypass allowing login without valid credentials
remediation: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements

title: SQL Injection Data Exposure
impact: Exposure of sensitive user data from the database
remediation: Use parameterized queries and input validation

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
impact: Execution of arbitrary JavaScript in a victim browser
remediation: Sanitize user input and encode output

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting
impact: Persistent malicious script executes whenever stored content is viewed
remediation: Sanitize and encode data before storage and display
